fieldValues.title: Review group PRs
fieldValues.description: Review open wg:third-party-ready PRs built by an earlier run: run the gates, list findings, post the quorum comment, then add gate:auto-merge.
fieldValues.done_when: Every open group PR built by an earlier run has a quorum comment or a findings comment (gh search: no open wg:third-party-ready PR without either).
